text: TitanCorp cancelled its APAC enterprise renewal after a budget freeze; renewal value was concentrated in the Enterprise channel.
APAC online and retail customers show no broad increase in cancellation or churn complaints.
EMEA checkout page latency rose by approximately 600 milliseconds, with the largest conversion loss on Paid Search mobile sessions.
Payment-step failures increased across EMEA traffic sources, especially mobile users; no single acquisition channel fully explains the decline.
LATAM payment gateway failover was deployed after a 13-day outage and checkout success has returned to baseline.
Global SMB cancellation surveys contain mixed reasons and no dominant complaint theme across tenure cohorts.
AI Copilot launched 12 days ago and the general-availability cohort is still being ramped in batches.
North America online orders are stable; no major campaign began or ended during the current comparison window.
